trigger: Native 3DMark03 GT4 snapshot waited while GPU completion callbacks kept executing queued FIFO draws after the CPU had stopped.
behavior: Snapshot preparation sets a temporary quiescing guard, commits the submitted GPU batch and query, and leaves unsubmitted commands plus their GET/PUT positions in device state. Normal wait() retains recursive drain behavior. On resume, regular device/FIFO polling executes the remaining work.

gpuRegression.commands: Two additive draws, REF, two more additive draws, REF

atQuiescence.REF: previous value; queued REF not executed
